name: Skool
description: is a modern restaurant in Canggu, Bali, that blends primitive cooking with a modern dining experience. It features an open-flame kitchen using natural wood and charcoal to cook all its dishes, from appetizers to desserts, and even cocktails. Located above The Lawn, the restaurant offers a fine-dining experience with ocean views and a focus on high-quality, produce-driven cuisine.
priceRange: Approx. IDR 300.000–500.000 per person (based on mains, cocktails, and higher-end dishes)
